description: Update an existing Scheduled Maintenance State Timeline in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_scheduled_maintenance_state_timeline afterwards to see the updated record.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Scheduled Maintenance State Timeline to update. Required. Use list_scheduled_maintenance_state_timelines to find IDs.

scheduledMaintenanceStateId.description: Scheduled Maintenance State ID. Which state does this event belongs to?

startsAt.description: When did this status change? Correct this when the recorded time is wrong - every measurement derived from this timeline is recomputed from the corrected value.

name: update_scheduled_maintenance_state_timeline
title: Update Scheduled Maintenance State Timeline
